deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout started for model redwood/llama-3-7b-quant (release: 2026-03-15T14:02Z). Weightset id ws-20260315-14abc. Canary traffic 10% in us-west-2. Watch logs: /deploys/2026-03-15/14/

samantha (oncall): Noted. I'm paged and looking. Can someone grab canary logs and any 5xx/latency spikes?

lucas (sre): Looking now. Initial metrics show 2% increase in 500 responses from the gateway hitting canary hosts. Correlating with model-serving nodes 10-12.

maya (mleng): I see repeated tokenizer errors in the canary pod logs:

```
2026-03-15T14:04:11Z ERROR TokenizationError: unknown byte sequence at offset 234
stack: Tokenizer.decode -> Tokenizer._load_vocab -> KeyError('x9f')
model_meta: weightset=ws-20260315-14abc, tokenizer_hash=3f7a9b
```

maya (mleng): The tokenizer_hash for this weightset doesn't match the tokenizer we expected (prod tokenizer_hash=7a4d12). Could be a weightset packaging issue where tokenizer files weren't updated.

eric (infra): Confirmed: the bundle manifest for ws-20260315-14abc references tokenizer v3 but the artifact actually contains tokenizer v2 assets. Manifest checksum: a1b2c3 -> bundle checksum mismatch.

olivia (support): Heads up — two customers reported gibberish completions around 14:05. Ticket IDs: #CS-4721, #CS-4723. Both describe bad token decoding mid-response.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident #INC-20260315-084 assigned to samantha (oncall) (sev=2).

samantha (oncall): Escalating to ml-eng. maya, can you confirm customer-facing impact and advice for immediate mitigation?

maya (mleng): Root cause looks like incorrect tokenizer files bundled with the weightset (packaging bug in release pipeline). Risk: decoded outputs contain invalid tokens -> user-visible corruption. Suggest two actions: 1) flip model-serving feature flag to route traffic away from ws-20260315-14abc canaries; 2) trigger rollback to previous weightset ws-20260314-991 which passed canary.

lucas (sre): I can flip the flag. Plan: set feature flag `model.routing.canary_ws_20260315` = false and force traffic to ws-20260314-991. That should stop new requests hitting the bad bundle within ~30s TTL.

eric (infra): Also propose we immediately mark ws-20260315-14abc as quarantined in the weight registry to prevent accidental promotion. I'll run: `redwood weights quarantine ws-20260315-14abc --reason "tokenizer-mismatch"`

samantha (oncall): Do it. Lucas proceed with flag flip. Eric quarantine. Maya prepare a quick patch to repackage tokenizer and CI check to prevent this. Olivia, start customer comms: "We're rolling back a canary release due to tokenization issues; we're investigating root cause."

lucas (sre): Executing flag flip now: `flags set model.routing.canary_ws_20260315 false --env prod`
lucas (sre): Flag applied. Canary traffic dropping, routing now to ws-20260314-991. Observability: 504s/500s on canary hosts dropping in the next minute.

eric (infra): Quarantine command issued: `redwood weights quarantine ws-20260315-14abc --by eric --ticket INC-20260315-084` -> success. Artifact removed from promotion queue.

maya (mleng): I'll open a PR to repackage tokenizer with the correct vocab and add a post-build tokenizer-hash validation step in the release pipeline. Also preparing a migration plan to re-run canary after validation.

olivia (support): Customer comms sent: "We detected an encoding/regression in a canary release and have rolled back traffic. Investigating; we will follow up with an ETA." CS has asked for an incident timeline.

samantha (oncall): Monitoring shows error rate back to baseline for production traffic. Good. Putting incident in progress state.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-20260315-084 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (by flag flip & rollback). Actions logged.

maya (mleng): Postmortem action items: 1) enforce tokenizer hash validation in release pipeline (blocking), 2) add canary log alert for TokenizationError pattern, 3) pre-deploy artifact sanity check script, 4) test against subset of prod tokenizer vocab during staging.

lucas (sre): Suggest adding emergency runbook entry for "tokenizer mismatch during rollout" with steps: quarantine weightset, flip routing flag, notify oncall + ml-eng, rollback to previous weightset.

eric (infra): I'll also add a quick check to registry that fails promote if tokenizer_hash != expected in manifest.

samantha (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll keep INC-20260315-084 open for postmortem until follow-ups are done. If anyone sees further related alerts, @samantha (oncall) to re-open. :white_check_mark:
